digest.episode_summary: Completed level 1 in 15 actions by routing the movable block to a small state-changing marker, then routing it to the enclosed target after the displayed pattern matched.

The directly controlled object is the 5x5 two-tone block; each successful directional action translated it exactly five cells while the small 0/1 glyph remained stationary until contact.

memories.claim: In level 1, after the bottom display matched the color-9 pattern in the enclosed chamber, moving the block onto that chamber pattern completed the level.

block can enter through a five-cell-wide passage
